policies.privacy:
Wayne's Fashion respects your privacy.

What we collect: your name, phone number, email, address and order details — only so we can fill and deliver your order.

How we use it: to process orders, contact you about delivery times, and send order updates by text or email. We never sell or rent your information.

Payments: payments are made through Zelle, Venmo, Cash App or Square. We do not store your card details on this website.

Text messages: by placing an order you agree to receive order-related texts. Message and data rates may apply.

Questions? Call 626-360-9820 or visit us at 2308 N Lincoln Ave.
policies.refund:
Clothing & accessories: unworn items with tags may be returned within 14 days with receipt for exchange or store credit.

Custom / screen-printed items: custom orders are made just for you and are final sale once printing begins.

Christmas trees: orders may be cancelled for a full refund up to 24 hours before scheduled pickup or delivery. Once a tree is cut, netted or out for delivery it is final sale. If there is a problem with your tree, contact us within 48 hours and we'll make it right.

Delivery fees are non-refundable once the delivery has been made.

To request a refund, call 626-360-9820 or visit the store.
